heading: Thursday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance of showers until around midnight, mainly north. Areas of fog. Lows from the mid 40s to lower 50s north, and low to mid 50s in the south, with some upper 50s possible far south. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming west and diminishing.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly cloudy after any early fog. Showers likely in southern New Hampshire, mainly after noon; slight chance north to the White Mountains and in southern Vermont; chance of late-day showers in far northern New York. Highs from upper 50s to mid 60s north, mid to upper 60s south. Variable winds around 5 mph.

heading: Friday Night
text: Showers likely in southern and central New Hampshire, chance in southern Vermont and in the Northeast Kingdom. Lows in the 40s, some 30s in the Adirondacks. Winds becoming light and variable.
